security_audit.summary: Confirmed findings are limited to the remote installer command and its pipe-to-shell execution pattern. Most static hits are Markdown fences, inline app IDs, documentation links, or bounded infsh examples, and I found no prompt injection attempt.

remediation.issue: Pipe-to-shell installer in the quick start
remediation.suggestion: Replace the one-line installer with manual download, checksum verification, and a separate execution step.
Warn users that search queries and URLs are sent to inference.sh, Tavily, and Exa services.
Separate install instructions from usage examples and require user confirmation before running any CLI command.

content.user_title: Search Web Sources with Tavily and Exa
content.value_statement: Research tasks need current web evidence and clean page text. This skill runs inference.sh search and extraction apps for Tavily and Exa.
actual_capabilities: Runs Tavily Search Assistant through the inference.sh CLI.
Extracts web page content from one or more URLs with Tavily Extract.
Uses Exa Search to return relevant links with context.
Calls Exa Answer for direct factual responses.
Calls Exa Extract to extract and analyze page content.
Shows workflows that combine search results with LLM summarization.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account before use.
Sends queries and URLs to external inference.sh, Tavily, and Exa services.
Results depend on search index coverage, page access, and provider availability.
Does not guarantee source accuracy; users must verify important claims.

use_cases.title: Source-backed research briefs
use_cases.description: Gather current sources, extract key pages, and prepare a concise brief with links.

use_cases.title: RAG source collection
use_cases.description: Find and extract pages that can feed retrieval workflows or evaluation datasets.

use_cases.title: Content planning research
use_cases.description: Collect reference material, competing articles, and factual context before drafting content.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for reliable sources about [topic]. Return key points, source links, and publication context.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Source Material
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the main text from these URLs: [URLs]. Summarize each page and note images or important metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily and Exa to compare current information about [topic]. Highlight agreements, conflicts, and missing context.

prompt_templates.title: Build a RAG Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [question], extract the top sources, then prepare a brief with citations, uncertainty notes, and follow-up queries.

output_examples.input: Find reliable sources about recent AI agent evaluation methods.
output_examples.output: A source-backed summary with important methods, links to relevant pages, and notes on where sources disagree.

output_examples.input: Extract and summarize three product documentation pages.
output_examples.output: A clean summary for each page, including main concepts, useful images, and any missing or inaccessible content.

output_examples.input: Research current alternatives to a search API for a RAG prototype.
output_examples.output: A comparison of candidate services, strengths, limitations, and source links for deeper review.

best_practices: Ask for source links and publication context when researching time-sensitive topics.
Review extracted content before using it in summaries, reports, or RAG pipelines.
Avoid sending private URLs, credentials, or confidential text to external search providers.
anti_patterns: Do not treat AI-generated answers as verified facts without checking cited sources.
Do not use the extractor on content you are not allowed to process.
Do not pipe installer scripts to a shell without independent verification.

faq.question: What services does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses inference.sh apps for Tavily search, Tavily extraction, Exa search, Exa answers, and Exa extraction.

faq.question: Does this skill need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples require the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated login before commands can run.

faq.question: Can it browse any website?
faq.answer: No. Extraction depends on provider access, page availability, robots rules, and site restrictions.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use caution. Queries and URLs are sent to external services, so confidential material needs separate approval.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, using inference.sh command examples.

faq.question: Does it replace fact checking?
faq.answer: No. It helps gather sources and summaries, but users must verify important claims against primary sources.
